response.evidence: The dataset contains many Asian applicants (including Asian males) with Loan originated entries; there are a few Asian-denied cases (e.g., Asian Female 35-44 denied; Asian Male 25-34 denied; Asian Male 45-54 denied), but overall the share of approvals for Asian applicants is high and not obviously lower than other groups; no clear pattern of discrimination against Asians is evident in this data.
